title: DISASSEMBLY OF PISTON AND CONNECTING ROD ASSEMBLY

content.text: DISASSEMBLY OF PISTON AND CONNECTING ROD ASSEMBLY

content.description: Hand holding piston and checking fit between piston and pin by rocking motion

items.title: CHECK FIT BETWEEN PISTON AND PIN
items.text: Rock the piston back and forth on the piston pin. If any movement is felt, replace the piston and pin.

content.description: Hand using piston ring expander tool to remove piston rings

items.title: REMOVE PISTON RINGS
items.text: Using a piston ring expander, remove the piston rings. Keep the rings for each cylinder separated.

content.description: Using needle-nose pliers to remove snap rings from piston

steps.text: Using needle-nose pliers, remove the snap rings from the piston.
Heat the piston in hot water to approx. 60°C (140°F).

content.description: Using plastic-faced hammer and driver to tap pin from piston

items.text: Using a plastic-faced hammer and driver, tap the pin lightly to remove the pin from the piston.

items: The piston and pin are a matched set.
Keep the piston, piston pin and rings and connecting rod together for each cylinder.

content.text: INSPECTION OF PISTON AND CONNECTING ROD ASSEMBLY

content.description: Hand scraping carbon from piston top and cleaning ring grooves

steps.text: Scrape any carbon from the piston top.
Using a grooved cleaning tool or broken ring, clean the ring grooves.
Using a brush and solvent, clean the piston thoroughly.

content.text: Do not use a wire brush.
